stem: Two irrigation sources arrive at nearly the same pH, but one has substantially higher alkalinity. What is the strongest long-term root-zone interpretation?
choices: They will affect root-zone pH identically because current pH matches
The higher-alkalinity source can exert greater acid-neutralizing pressure over repeated irrigations, so alkalinity must be managed separately from pH
Alkalinity is simply another name for pH
rationale: pH describes current hydrogen-ion activity while alkalinity describes acid-neutralizing capacity delivered with irrigation. Similar pH values can therefore have different long-term buffering effects.
